vnyan.send.description: Sends a message to VNyan that runs your node graph: every "API Message" node with the same name starts, for example to throw something at your model or change an expression.

fields.action: The name you typed into the API Message node in VNyan, for example Wave. Capital letters matter.
fields.payload: Optional extra values the node can use, one name=value per line, for example user=%user%.
